t: Buy Canadian movement offers opportunities amid heightened emotions
s: March 27, 2025 - Some Canadian companies in the business-to-business (B2B) space are reconsidering their contracts and pivoting towards domestic suppliers. The Buy Canadian movement’s influence is evident in services as well, especially in travel and tourism.
